Container.Name: qtopo-server
Container.Overview: QLD and NSW topographic map tiles with a browser map and read-only activity dashboard. Styles, cached tiles and retained NSW 2 m contour packages persist in /data. NSW contour preparation starts automatically in supported images and retains approximately 29.2 GB of source downloads plus prepared tiles. Storage cleanup protects files in use and removes old unused cache files when either storage threshold is reached.

Config.Name: Web and tile port
Config.Description: Open the map and status page on this host port. Change it if another container already uses 9878.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Styles, cached tiles and retained NSW contour packages. Allow 29.2 GB for contour source downloads plus prepared tiles and working space. Use a separate folder for each running QTopo container.

Config.Name: Maximum cache size (GiB)
Config.Description: Maximum combined managed tile and resource cache size. Removes the oldest unused files when exceeded; files in use and styles are protected. 0 disables this limit.

Config.Name: Minimum free disk space (GiB)
Config.Description: Start removing old unused cache files when a cache filesystem has less free space than this, even below the cache-size limit. 0 disables this threshold.

Config.Name: Prepare NSW 2 m contours at boot
Config.Description: 1 downloads and prepares the complete official NSW 2 m contour catalogue in the background. Retains about 29.2 GB of source archives plus prepared tiles; progress resumes after restarts. 0 disables preparation and the profile. Available in images supporting NSW 2 m contours.

Config.Name: Retained NSW contour directory
Config.Description: Persistent container path for original archives and prepared contour tiles. Outside the disposable tile cache and its 20 GiB limit. If changed, map this path to persistent storage; keep it separate from vector, raster and resources cache folders.

Config.Name: NSW contour processing threads
Config.Description: 1-8 threads for background contour preparation. One sheet is processed at a time at reduced CPU priority.

Config.Name: NSW contour retry interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Retry failed or paused preparation after this interval, 5-3600 seconds. Minimum free disk space also applies to the retained contour directory; sources are never automatically deleted.

Config.Name: Default appearance
Config.Description: Style for the map and unqualified tile URLs. Use readable or mobile, or the name of an installed profile.

Config.Name: Render workers
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous render workers, 1-24. The memory guard may use fewer workers when RAM is limited.

Config.Name: Nearby prefetch radius
Config.Description: Prepare neighbouring tiles within this radius, 0-10. 0 disables nearby prefetch.

Config.Name: Prefetch neighbouring zoom levels
Config.Description: 1 prepares nearby zoom levels at lowest priority; 0 disables zoom prefetch.

Config.Name: Memory guard
Config.Description: 1 adapts render concurrency to available RAM; 0 disables adaptive throttling. Docker still enforces the container Memory limit.

Config.Name: Worker recycling threshold (MiB)
Config.Description: Replace a worker after its completed render if resident memory reaches this value, 64-4096 MiB. This fixed retention threshold is not a per-render memory limit or calculated from the container RAM allocation.
